lines.l: All it took to bother you
Every word I said was true
I'm the only one who sees
I still refuse, all the methods you abuse
It's alright if you're confused, let me be
I've been around, all the pawns you gagged and mad
He'll come back and knock you down, knock you free
I'm taking on the love and the good
One day it all will fade out short
In the tunnels and wind and lands
I looked in and I was shown
I'll stick around, I'll stick around
Don't follow me, don't see my head
I'll stick around, I'll stick around
I'll stick around, I'll stick around
No sign of mine will ever do
The work of villains, the work of fools
If you believe it, it must be true
No sweat of mine, no sweat of mine
